software_update_and_ios.definition: Customer issues or questions regarding iOS updates, software upgrades, beta releases, update installation failures, or post-update bugs.
positive_examples: My iPhone 6 is stuck on the iOS 11 update screen.
Ever since I updated to iOS 11.1 my phone has been freezing constantly.
How do I install the latest software update on my iPad?
negative_examples: My battery is draining fast after the update.
software_update_and_ios.boundary_cases: If the message explicitly attributes a specific hardware symptom (like battery drain) to an update, primary intent is software_update_and_ios if focusing on the update process, or battery_and_power if focusing solely on power performance.

battery_and_power.definition: Customer reports of fast battery drain, battery health degradation, charging problems, charger cables, or device shutting down unexpectedly.
positive_examples: My battery drops from 80% to 10% in less than an hour.
iPhone won't charge when plugged into the lightning cable.
My phone keeps dying at 30% battery percentage.
negative_examples: My phone screen is black and won't turn on.
battery_and_power.boundary_cases: If the device won't turn on due to a cracked screen vs dead battery, classify under hardware_and_display unless charging behavior is explicitly mentioned.

app_store_and_downloads.definition: Problems downloading, purchasing, updating, or opening applications from the Apple App Store, or app crashing issues.
positive_examples: I cannot download apps from the App Store, it just keeps spinning.
Twitter app keeps crashing every time I try to open it on my iPad.
Unable to purchase apps because my payment method was declined in App Store.
negative_examples: I was billed twice for my Apple Music subscription.
app_store_and_downloads.boundary_cases: If payment is declined specifically in App Store for app download, it is app_store_and_downloads. If it is an unknown credit card charge from Apple, it is apple_pay_and_billing.

hardware_and_display.definition: Physical device damage, screen cracks, unresponsive touch screen, camera malfunction, home/power button failures, or speaker hardware issues.
positive_examples: My iPhone screen is cracked and touch isn't responding.
The front camera on my iPhone 7 displays a black screen when opened.
My home button stopped clicking after dropping the phone.
negative_examples: My Bluetooth headphones won't pair with my phone.
hardware_and_display.boundary_cases: Physical button failure is hardware_and_display, while volume/sound issues caused by software settings belong to audio_and_airpods.

itunes_and_apple_music.definition: Inquiries or technical issues regarding iTunes music sync, Apple Music streaming, playlist loss, or local media library management.
positive_examples: All my downloaded songs disappeared from Apple Music library.
iTunes on Windows won't recognize my iPhone when connected via USB.
How do I sync my music playlist from my Mac to my iPhone?
negative_examples: How do I back up my device photos to iCloud?
itunes_and_apple_music.boundary_cases: Syncing music specifically via iTunes/Apple Music is itunes_and_apple_music. General iCloud device backup is icloud_and_storage.

connectivity_and_cellular.definition: Issues with Wi-Fi connectivity, Bluetooth pairing, cellular network signal, 'No SIM Installed' errors, or AirDrop failures.
positive_examples: My iPhone keeps disconnecting from home Wi-Fi network.
Getting 'No SIM Card Installed' error on my iPhone 6s.
Bluetooth won't turn on or discover any nearby devices.
connectivity_and_cellular.boundary_cases: If Bluetooth disconnects specifically affect AirPods/headphones, classify under audio_and_airpods. General Bluetooth pairing with cars/speakers is connectivity_and_cellular.

apple_id_and_security.definition: Forgotten passwords, Apple ID account lockouts, two-factor authentication code issues, passcode recovery, or security verification.
positive_examples: I forgot my Apple ID password and my account is locked.
Not receiving two-factor verification code on my trusted phone number.
I got locked out of my iPhone because I forgot my passcode.
negative_examples: I want to change my credit card on my account.
apple_id_and_security.boundary_cases: If account is locked due to security/passcode, it is apple_id_and_security. If user wants to edit billing methods, it is apple_pay_and_billing.

icloud_and_storage.definition: iCloud storage full warnings, photo backup/sync issues, cloud drive access, or device storage management.
positive_examples: My iCloud storage is full and my photos won't back up.
How do I buy more iCloud storage space on my phone?
iCloud photo library is not syncing between my iPad and iPhone.
negative_examples: I can't download a 2GB game from the App Store.
icloud_and_storage.boundary_cases: Device local storage vs iCloud cloud storage: if mentioning iCloud explicitly, classify as icloud_and_storage.

apple_pay_and_billing.definition: Unexpected charges, refund requests for purchases, Apple Pay contactless payment failures, or subscription renewals.
positive_examples: I saw an unauthorized charge of $9.99 from Apple on my bank statement.
How do I request a refund for an accidental subscription renewal?
Apple Pay was declined at the store checkout terminal.
negative_examples: My App Store app download failed.
apple_pay_and_billing.boundary_cases: Unrecognized financial charges or refund requests belong to apple_pay_and_billing.

audio_and_airpods.definition: Sound quality, volume level issues, microphone failures during calls, or AirPods connectivity and charging case issues.
positive_examples: My right AirPod is much quieter than the left one.
People cannot hear me during phone calls, microphone is distorted.
AirPods won't charge inside the charging case.
negative_examples: My phone speaker doesn't work after water damage.
audio_and_airpods.boundary_cases: Physical water damage to speaker hardware is hardware_and_display, whereas AirPods specific audio/charging issues are audio_and_airpods.

general_inquiry_or_other.definition: General product inquiries, trade-in questions, store location queries, shipping status of Apple Store orders, or non-technical support questions.
positive_examples: Will the Apple Store be open tomorrow on Thanksgiving?
How much trade-in value can I get for my iPhone 7?
When will my Apple order ship to my home address?
negative_examples: My iPhone 6 is stuck on the iOS update screen.
general_inquiry_or_other.boundary_cases: Any query that does not fall into technical support categories or is a general customer service question.
